title: add atomic registry-sync + flatcar/k3os airgap bundle generation
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation and summary: This PR enhances the private installer airgap tooling to support atomic registry synchronization semantics and adds first-class output for Flatcar Container Linux and k3OS targets. Customers running immutable-rootfs distributions and appliance-like nodes have been running into partial-pull failures and excessive disk usage during large bundle installs. The new atomic registry-sync produces a transactionally-applied set of image layers and metadata on the mirror registry so installs either complete successfully or leave the mirror unchanged.

What changed: - New binary 'airgap-regsync' (go) which performs: pull -> verify -> push to mirror -> commit marker. It uses a two-phase commit marker file in the mirror registry metadata namespace to ensure consumers only see completed syncs. - Image set minimizer: computes the minimal image layer subset needed for a requested release (uses manifest diffing across stable/runtime images) to drastically shrink bundle size for constrained networks. - OS-specific manifests: templates and hooks for Flatcar and k3OS that handle overlayfs/immutable root constraints, systemd unit changes, and container runtime config adjustments (containerd snapshotter flags). - Terraform module updates: redwood-terraform/mirror now exposes variables for commit-marker TTL, blob GC window, and registry object prefixes so infra teams can configure multi-repo mirrors. - Installer preflight checks: ensures enough image cache space, verifies kernel cmdline flags required by k3OS/Flatcar, and validates that the target mirror implements blob range requests (for partial layer resume). - Rollback safety: the installer will roll back mirror pointer on failed post-install hooks and will trigger GC-unpublished for orphan layer cleanup.

Key files changed (high-level): - cmd/airgap-regsync/main.go (new) - pkg/registrysync/commit.go (new) - tooling/bundle/minimizer.go (new) - manifests/os/flatcar/{installer.service,containerd.conf}.tmpl (new) - manifests/os/k3os/{preflight.sh,layout.yml}.tmpl (new) - terraform/modules/mirror/variables.tf (updated) - scripts/mirror/gc-safety-check.sh (updated) - ci/airgap-integration.yml (updated tests)

Commits (summary): - add airgap-regsync two-phase commit implementation - wire minimizer into bundle generator - add flatcar and k3os templates + preflight logic - expose mirror configuration in terraform module - add integration tests for partial network and commit marker semantics - fix: resume logic on interrupted downloads and retry backoff tuning

Testing and CI: - New integration pipeline 'airgap-integration' runs emulated mirror (registry:2) and small node VMs to validate registry commit semantics and installer preflight. - Initial CI run failed on partial-resume (blob range support) with flaky network simulation; fixed by falling back to multipart download and re-enabling compressed manifest handling. Current CI status: pass.

Review notes and migration: - Operators using older mirror workflows will need to run a one-time sync with the --migrate-markers flag to convert existing mirror state into the new committed layout (tool will back up original tags under _legacy/). - Default GC policy is unchanged; enabling commit markers without GC window increase may temporarily double storage usage; terraform variable doc updated to recommend GC window >= 24h for large installs. - k3OS/Flatcar templates are opt-in: users must set os_distribution to flatcar or k3os in the bundle config to receive the specialized systemd units.

Release notes: Generate smaller airgap bundles for Flatcar and k3OS; transactional registry sync reduces partial mirror visibility; additional preflight checks for immutable OSes.

Known issues: - Some older registry mirrors (pre-2.7) do not support the metadata namespace used for commit-markers; fallback mode is enabled but loses atomic guarantees. - Image minimizer currently ignores non-container artifacts (VM images) — will follow up in a separate PR.

Rollout plan: - Canary: enable for 5 internal customers with mirrors in EU-W and a config gate in console. - Monitor installer success rate, mirror storage delta, and GC operations for 72h post-deploy. - If regressions seen, roll back marker usage by toggling terraform variable mirror_enable_commit_markers=false (no data plane change required).

Related tickets: Linear ENG-1923, ENG-2104.

Links: internal design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1923/atomic-registry-sync

review_conversation: Liam Chen (reviewer): Nice work on the two-phase marker idea — can you add a short doc on marker format (so ops can introspect)?
Ava Martinez (author): Added README-airgap.md with marker layout and example curl queries to inspect committed state.
Priya Rao (reviewer): Terraform variable names look good. Please ensure default TTL isn't too small for large mirrors.
Ava Martinez (author): Default TTL set to 48h in variables.tf; added note recommending 24-72h depending on mirror size.
Ethan Brooks (reviewer): CI flakes still showed on intermittent range requests — do we have a fallback?
Ava Martinez (author): Yes, added multipart resume fallback and additional tests. CI green after that change.
